name: Floor Back Extension
steps: Lie face down with your legs straight, toes resting on the floor and fingertips beside your temples.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes to stabilize your pelvis against the floor.
Lift your chest and upper torso smoothly off the floor by contracting your lower back while keeping your feet anchored down.
Pause briefly at a comfortable height, then lower your chest slowly back down to the floor.
tips: Keep your gaze directed toward the floor ahead of you so your neck stays neutral rather than craning upward.
Lift through a controlled range without jerking or forcing extreme lower-back hyperextension.
